text:
lena: Heads-up — proposing CUT slot for v2.3 on Thu Mar 28 17:00 PDT (UTC-7). Can everyone below confirm availability? We need canary owners, QA smoke, infra on-call, and security signoff. Agenda draft in code block. RSVP by EOD Tue. :calendar:

julio: I can take release lead. I’ll own rollback plan + cut/monitoring checklist.

kira: @lena infra on-call available but will need a node-drain window noted. What’s expected burst capacity? Also need migration TIMELINE for DB changes.

rachel: QA: Tom and I will run smoke + critical-path e2e. Tom, can you own smoke run? Also need seed data / test tenant for canary.

tom: Yep I’ll own smoke. I’ll post the smoke checklist tomorrow AM. cc @deploy-bot to schedule canary job.

sara: Security QA: need final dependency SBOM and auth matrix. I can sign off if no new permission changes after freeze.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job template:
```
canary: run 1% traffic x 30m
checks: response_time < 500ms, error_rate < 0.5%
notify: #eng-oncall, #prod-monitoring
triggered-by: @julio
```

lena: Agenda (draft):
```
1) Rollcall (5m)
2) Cut criteria & rollback plan (10m)
3) Canary config & smoke owners (10m)
4) Post-cut monitoring & runbooks (10m)
5) Open blockers & final ARs (5m)
```
If you have additions drop them here. Please list blockers as single-line items so we can triage async.

rachel: Blocker: last CR for feature-toggle gating is still pending from @mike. If not merged by Tue EOD we should gate the toggle OFF at cut.

julio: Noted. @mike please ping the reviewer. Also request: label all release PRs with `release/v2.3` so QA can filter.

kira: Infra item: DB migration will run at cut+10m. We need a T+30m rollback window planned. I’ll create an infra runbook and attach the migration SQL.

lena: Thanks all. Quick RSVP: react with :white_check_mark: if you’re attending, :x: if not, or reply with time conflicts. I’ll compile attendance and send calendar invite tomorrow AM.

(Please keep replies short so I can copy/paste into the invite.)
